results.title: Patrick Stewart Declares He Will Never Retire Amid 40th Star Trek Anniversary
results.description: Renowned actor Patrick Stewart, aged 86, confirmed in his final interview that he still intends to continue acting, citing ongoing passion and new opportunities, while reflecting on a distinguished career that included Captain Jean‑Luc Picard. The news arrives shortly after Stewart's passing and highlights his legacy in Star Trek: The Next Generation and later films, as well as his post‑humous role in Avengers: Doomsday.
